en: No, yer not fine...
This is nothing. Let's just go back to the village.
Ugh... You kicked my ass at slugging <Italic>and</Italic> brawling. Who are you?
Just a random customer. Now you treat bats with respect, all right? Or else.
Yessir! Roger that! I'll never misuse them again!
Here, this is for causing you trouble. Take it, please.
From now on, please feel free to use the Tokai Wonderkid title. I'm not worthy of it anymore.
Uh, thanks but no thanks.
Holy shit. What a batter.
There. Are you satisfied, Tokai Wonderkid-san?
Okay. I'm outta here.
You're not walking away and leaving me the loser. That stresses me out, you know? I'm gonna have to work that off, too.
Oh boy. Should've seen this coming.
If you want to apologize for getting uppity with me, here's your chance.
Bow down to some goofballs who don't respect their bats? Not about to happen.
Heh. Have it your way. I'll show you how to use a bat properly. Get him, boys!
Heh. This batter's all talk. I'm still the best.
You can baby your bat all you want, but that won't help you hit a home run. You get that now?
(I can't believe I lost to this scumbag...)
Hey, that was fun, though. I'll take you on anytime. 'Cause I'm the Tokai Wonderkid! Hahaha!
Gwaah! What's with this guy? He's freaking tough.
Huh, guess you guys are all talk.
Boys? What's going on?
Oh! Uh, nothing, Tsutsukubo-san!
What now? Are you their boss or something?
Yeah, I am. What's it to you?
This dickhead started harassing us, saying don't mistreat bats and other lame shit. I think you should kick his ass!
Huh. Don't mistreat bats, eh? So what, this guy's some sort of baseball fanatic? Wait a minute...
I knew it. I saw your face on a blog. You're the wicked batter of Nagoya.
(Great. Thanks, Kotetsu.)
Hahahaha! This is perfect! I've been meaning to see how good you are.
So, we doing this or what?
Doing what? Another fight?
No, man. Baseball.

Tsutsukubo-san here used to be called the Tokai Wonderkid
back when he batted cleanup! I mean, sure, he's just a lowly
street thug now, but still! The man represents!
Care to repeat that, dumbshit?
Oh! Uh... Sorry!
Well, I guess he's not that far off. Anyway, you ready go at it?
No, not really. Why's it gotta be me?
The blog said you were the best slugger in Nagoya. Which is bullshit, because I'm the best.
Oh, is that how it is? Well, we're both batters. How do you propose we do this?
Gotta be a home run derby.
Now you're speaking my language.
Okay, how do you wanna settle this? It's not too late, you know. You can still get down on your knees and beg forgiveness.
Yeah, like that'll ever happen.
Hehehe, is that right? You should be worrying about yourself, and not some cheapshit bat!
This here's one of my favorite spots. Go ahead n' help yourself.
Thanks. Don't mind if I do.
So... if you'll allow me a word, I wanted t'apologize for getting ya involved.
You said those guys were called the Devil Killers?
Yeah. The Nagasu Devil Killers. Pretty much got the run of this place.
Way back they used to focus more on racing, but now they're just a typical gang, getting up to all sorts of mischief.
But this has turned into something else. I can tell they want to bring ya down bad.
Guys like them won't let up once they got you in their sights. Y'can count on them challenging you again.
If that's the case, what do you suggest I do?
Honestly... I wanna see ya leave 'em all sucking exhaust fumes. Every time they challenge you, crush 'em.
Dead serious. I've seen what y'can do, and I know ya got a shot at this, no matter what ya think.
(He's crazy...)
Speed is everything to these punks. No matter how hard we crack down on 'em, they keep comin' back. They live for the thrill of winning.
Only way to stop 'em is to humiliate 'em at what they hold sacred. Win, and they'll scatter like roaches.
Much as I'd like to, I can't go head-to-head with these punks in a cop car. It'd only tarnish the badge.
So we need someone pickin' up the gauntlet on our behalf.
And that's where I come in?
Yer the only one I know at this point who can do it. Given the opportunity, I reckon y'could bring the entire squad to their knees.
Whaddya say? We can't just let these vigilantes keep running rampant!
They've been causin' absolute chaos these last few months. Things are goin' from bad to worse.
They used to only go after other street racers, but now it seems anyone's fair game.
Families, the elderly... Even other taxi drivers like you have been running afoul of 'em.
Taxi drivers too?
Yeah. If we let 'em have their way, it could be someone y'know who gets hit next.
(He has a point.)
C'mon, man! I've said my piece. I don't wanna let them cause any more trouble!
(I can't let that happen...)
Y'mean it?
Yeah. I'll do whatever I can.
Thanks! Then I'll be counting on you.
Oh, and help yourself to seconds! Can't race on an empty stomach, ya know!
Right, thanks.
Thanks for hearin' me out. I appreciate you steppin' up to help us.
Oh, yeah. I forgot to tell ya my name. I'm Furumichi, with the prefectural police. Good to meet ya. And you are?
Kir⑬ I mean, Suzuki.
I'll make sure the local police stay clear of your races. So go all out and get 'em, Suzuki-san!
(Great, now I'm racing the Devil Killers? What have I gotten myself into this time?)
Hey, old guy.
I need to blow off some steam. Come on, why don't you join me? Hehehe...
But, but... I don't want to go.
What'd you say? You don't want to bat against me? Huh? You got a problem with the way I pitch!?
Well, it's just that... Furugaki-san, you always throw wild. Everyone who goes up against you gets beaned.
So what? I don't see a problem with that. Now quit whining and get in there!
Noooo....
What was that about?
Oh, him? That's Furugaki, the Beanball Bully.
Beanball Bully? What's that supposed to mean?
He's got no ball control. People call him that for nailing all his opponents with beanballs.
The guy used to be a pitcher for his school team, but what with his bad attitude and hitting batters all the time, he ended up quitting.
Since then, he grabs other kids and makes them go up to bat against their will.
Of course, he ends up hitting most of them with beanballs, too.
Huh. Sounds like a real jerk.
Aaaugh!
Where do you think you're going?

You trying to piss me off? 'Cause it sure seems like you're
trying to piss me off. Goddamn near everything's trying to piss me off these days!
No... No more... I'm tired of getting hurt just so you can have fun.
Who cares what you say! You just keep your yap shut and plant your feet in the batter's box like a good little boy.
Please... If you could just help me...
...Good gravy.
Huh? Who's this ugly old oaf?

Look, I don't like seeing kids get bullied, especially when
it comes to baseball. This is supposed to be a fun pastime,
not an exercise in torture. Have some compassion.
Why should I? All I want is to pitch against someone. What's so wrong about that? Hey, maybe I should take you on for size.
You serious, kid?
Please. Just do it.
Is that what it takes to get rid of him? Sheesh... Well, I guess I'm stepping in for you then.
All right, all right. I'm cool with that. I like how you roll, old man.
But only on one condition. If I can get a hit off you, you stop forcing kids to be your targets.
Hah, as if! That ain't happening.

What, are you scared to lose? Some bully you are. I'd tell
you to drop the tough guy act, but you just did that for me.
What'd you say!? Ohhh, now you've done it. You're on! Come with me!
Okay, I'm gonna explain the rules again. I came up with these myself.
If you strike out, you lose. And since I got lousy control, balls don't get you a base.
Oh, and if you get hit by a pitch, you lose automatically.
You can only win by not getting beaned <Italic>and</Italic> getting a hit off me. Got it?
Fine, have it your way.

Hehehe, then let's get crackin'! Sorry if you get another
fastball to the face... NOT!
All right, let's do this. I'm gonna make you regret picking a fight with me.
Now, the rules. I came up with these myself.
What kind of busted-up rules are those? They're stacked completely in your favor.
I don't remember asking your opinion! Anyway, you can only win by not getting beaned and getting a hit off me.
Gee, how generous. But fine, have it your way.

Hehehe. Oh yeah. Best thing about it? It ain't my fault if
you get hurt. Try not to cry all the way to the infirmary!
No way... Unbelievable. You dodged my berserker beanballs <Italic>and</Italic> got a hit.
I sure did. Now you'd better keep your promise.
...All right. I'm done acting up. I mean it.
Good. Now, your control is brutal, but you really do have a mean pitch.
Why don't you quit messing around and develop some proper form?
But I... I always had rotten control. Practice won't make it better.
You only get to say that if you actually go to practice.
A guy who bailed on his team and causes a bunch of trouble doesn't have the right.

Heh. Maybe you have a point. Maybe I'm just... running away.
From effort, from reality, from baseball.
Furugaki-san... That's deep.
Dude, I'm sorry for what I put you through. I'm gonna go back to baseball for real. No more of this stupid shit.
Thanks for taking the time to show me the error of my ways. Here, you should have this.
I dunno how long it'll take, but the next time I face you, I'm gonna beat you. With a proper set of rules.
Heh. I look forward to it.
Hahaha! So much for your pompous preaching, old man!
I'll take you on anytime. If you're pissed, try shutting me down!
(Damn it. He got me.)
I've been waiting for this moment to arrive. And I don't expect you to pull any punches this time.
I'm gonna strike you out, regain my courage, and move on to pitching in the major leagues!
Kyuma! Why must you be such a nuisance? Stop this at once!
You stay out of this, sis! Shinada-san, let's go!
Excuse me! Are you Tatsuo Shinada? The one who played with the Wyverns?
Aha! I thought I recognized you from somewhere! When I walked by you swinging away in the cages, I could have sworn it was you.
I'm so lucky I ran into you again!
Lucky? What do you mean?
Oh, allow me to explain. My name is Kyuma Moroboshi. I'm forty, and I'm training to be a pitcher in the pros.
You're forty!? I don't mean to be rude, but most pros would be long retired by then. Don't you think it's a little too late?
Hey, we're free to chase our dreams however old we are! I want to pitch for the major leagues, and I won't give up until my dying breath!
Suit yourself. So what do you want from me?
I've been going to all the club tryouts every year, but they never call me back. At this age, I'm starting to get a bit discouraged.
So this is where you come in! I want you to help restore my waning confidence.
And just how am I gonna do that?
By letting me pitch against you. If I can strike out a professional athlete, then I'd know all my hard work hasn't been for naught.
Yeah, but I was a professional athlete fifteen years ago. And besides⑬
Kyuma! I thought I might find you here again!
Ack!

Why are you spending all your time on baseball instead of
focusing on work!? How sad would our father be to see you
like this?

Give me a break, sis! I'm in the middle of an important
man-to-man talk! My self-worth depends on it!
*sigh* I'm so sorry. My brother isn't bothering you, is he?
Haha, no. Not quite yet. Mind telling me what's up?

We lost our father young, you see. He left us with a tiny
screw factory that's hanging on by a thread, but this lazy
brother of mine only cares about chasing unrealistic dreams.
Ah, now I get the picture.
I keep telling you, I won't spend the rest of my days covered in grime and sweat at that crappy workshop!
Kyuma! How dare you say that about our father's factory!? He worked so hard so he could realize his dream of leaving it to you.
I don't care! I'm gonna strike out Shinada-san and regain my courage to keep chasing <Italic>my</Italic> dream!
You... will accept my challenge, won't you?
But what if I get a hit?
Hah. If I worried about losing, I would never play! I train hard every day. I can't lose to you, Shinada-san⑬you've been retired so long.
Please! Please accept my challenge. I'll compensate you properly for getting in the batter's box, too.
Oh, all right. But I'm not going to pull any punches. It's not my fault if I dent your confidence even more, okay?
